name: Bursting the door
description: A worked Might test — Orden shoulders through a barred iron door.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: The iron door is barred — and the chanting is getting faster.

lines.speaker: ORDEN
lines.text: I hit it shoulder-first. Might test!

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: The bar splinters — you're through, but ~~the noise carries~~.

name: The grapple
description: A worked Might resistance — Kaelen shrugs off a cultist's grab.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: The cultist lunges to grab you off the ledge.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: He bounces off — ~~prone~~ at your boots.

name: Kaelen swings
description: The Power Roll in action — Kaelen's Brutal Slam lands a tier 3.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: The bugbear rounds on you, Kaelen — roll it.

lines.speaker: KAELEN
lines.text: Brutal Slam — that's a **Might** ability. Rolling…

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: Tier 3: ~~7 damage~~ and a push into the brazier.

name: Into the lair
description: The Lich's Lair, part 1 — a stealth montage into the barrow.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: The barrow mouth breathes cold. Getting in unseen is a **montage**.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: I read the ward-glyphs — Reason test.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: The wards part like curtains — ~~one success~~.
